notes: Corrected s013 and s014: the accepted alignment mixed the two branches of rules 42 and 101, keeping out of whole on the adverb while still handing the article a determiner. Rule 101 states that rule 21's determiner and nothing else moves the trailing preposition, so an article taking that takes of that with it, headed on that under rules 17 and 21, and the adverb is left bare.

The two English that's are distributed between s014 and s019 under rules 60 and 76 rather than joined on the demonstrative; the joined reading, which would empty both articles under rule 38 and restore out of whole to ἔξω, is named in the s013 and s014 notes.
Every other unit is unchanged; the partition still covers s001–s025 and t001–t028 exactly once across 24 units.
